headline: Nvidia Faces California and SEC Inquiries Over Reported Chip Sales to China
summary: California's Attorney General and the U.S. SEC are investigating whether Nvidia misled investors regarding chip sales to China. Nvidia shares dropped more than 20% over a week following executive departures and regulatory scrutiny.
why: Nvidia is the primary designer of advanced graphics processing units (GPUs) essential for artificial intelligence workloads. Regulatory probes into potential securities or export control violations represent material legal risk for the semiconductor maker.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Concerns over regulatory subpoenas and potential accounting probes sent Nvidia shares down over 20% in a week.
